findings.summary: S5.6.7 never checks that the row's --home was under <Homes>\coai-vh\<8>, and TheOneShotHomeIsGone also passes when coai-vh does not exist, so a home made and left somewhere else (for example TEMP) would keep the 'coai-vh\<8> gone' check green.
findings.fix: In the answered and cancelled arms, read --home from the played launch and assert it is <Homes>\coai-vh\<8 hex>\kh-<10 hex>, as S5.5.1 does. Then assert that this folder is gone, not only that coai-vh is empty when it happens to exist.

findings.summary: The private Scopes class and the StandIn(KimiFixture) helper are copied word for word in AKimiConsultantCheckTests, AKimiQuestionRowTests and AKimiConsultationScenarioTests, which goes against the reuse-first rule.
findings.fix: Move Scopes and StandIn into one shared test helper (for example a static method beside KimiFixture or PlayedKimi) and call it from all three classes.
